tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis bzhugs// mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas// mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung*// bkra shis 'phel phyir rtag tu dran par 'gyur// pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid// yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos// he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma// bkra shis des ni skye dgu bde legs shog /sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab mar bde bar bzhugs// skye mched 'byung ba rnam par dag pa'i dngos// ye shes tshad med rang bzhin lha mo brgyad// bkra shis des ni skye dgu bde legs shog /khams drug dag pa ye shes chen po'i sku// lam gyi byang chub sum cu rtsa bdun te// snang ba sangs rgyas zhing 'gyur gzhal yas khang*// bkra shis des ni skye dgu bde legs shog /yan lag rnam dag khro bo chen po'i sku// rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba bla re gur// bdud dpung nges 'joms srung ba'i 'khor lo mchog /bkra shis des ni skye dgu bde legs shog /dag bya dag byed phyi'am nang na bzhugs// phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu dang sprin dang shing*// mchod rten ro dang 'dre dang me dang chu// phyogs brgyad dag byed des ni bkra shis shog /bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso bo 'khor dang bcas// sbyang gzhi dag byed lam dang 'bras bu mchog /brjod dam de don rtag tu dran yang rung*// bkra shis 'phel phyir rtag tu dran par 'gyur// bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// //oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca he ru ko bha wa/
ma hā sa ma ya satwa a hūm̐ phaṭa// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
